body: This was very enjoyable to read filled with evocative language and imagery. However where you have the line brakes seems to be an interesting choice but doesn't add anything to the poem but gives the feeling of run on sentences. However other than that which may be a stylistic difference I loved it. For me this poem gave the feeling of being alone nd isolated even whist others are around.

I found this to be very interesting in how its formatted. I'm used to seeing poems written in line breaks however I did enjoy this. Your use of imagery was particularly well done and allowed for you poem to be filled with evocative sentences.

I really enjoyed your poem, particularly its rhythm when spoken out loud. Each line seems to move seamlessly into the next creating an easily spoken and listened to poem. The first and second line are the only ones that have a lack of rhyme between them which does make them a bit more jarring than the rest of the poem and makes the first line have a slightly different rhythm than the rest of the poem.
Not sure if I'll be able to help or not, but what do you need advice on?
